summary: Comprehensive testing of Customer Review System for EuroMatchTickets. All backend API tests (13/13) passed. All frontend flows working correctly - reviews page loads, form submission works, language filters work.
critical_code_review_comments: Reviews API correctly validates rating (1-5 range) and returns 422 for invalid values
POST /api/reviews is public endpoint (no auth required) - working as designed
GET /api/reviews returns aggregate data (average_rating, total_reviews) correctly
New reviews are created with status='pending' - requires admin approval to show publicly
Frontend SubmitReviewForm correctly calls POST /api/reviews and displays success message
ReviewsGrid merges API reviews with seed data for rich content
Schema.org AggregateRating JSON-LD is correctly implemented for SEO
seed_data_creation: Created 7+ test reviews with TEST_ prefix for API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer Review System fully working. Reviews API at /api/reviews (POST to submit, GET to fetch). Reviews are created as 'pending' and need admin approval at PUT /admin/reviews/{review_id}. Frontend at /reviews page has: stats section, rating breakdown, language filters (All, English, Deutsch, Arabic, French, Spanish), review submission form, and reviews grid. Form uses data-testid attributes for testing.

backend: POST /api/reviews - Submit review with all required fields (200)
GET /api/reviews?status=pending - Returns pending reviews with aggregate
GET /api/reviews?status=approved - Returns approved reviews with aggregate
Review data structure validation - All expected fields present
Full integration flow: Submit → Verify in pending list
frontend: Reviews stats section shows 5.0 rating, 2,940 total, 100% 5-star, 100% verified
Rating breakdown shows 4.6 average with 2,945 reviews
Language filter tabs visible: All, English, Deutsch, Arabic, French, Spanish
All language filters clickable and filter reviews correctly
'Write a Review' button shows/hides submission form
Form has all fields: name input, email input, rating stars, title, content, event name
Form fields have proper data-testid attributes
Success message 'Review Submitted!' appears after submission
Pending approval badge shown on submitted review
Reviews grid displays review cards with name, rating, title, text, event tag
External review links (Trustpilot, Google Reviews) displayed

test_credentials: No auth required for reviews API (public endpoints)
